cs_ch1_0.speaker: Lorekeeper Aldous
cs_ch1_0.text: When the Chrono-Rifts tore open above Ashenvale Bastion, ancient stone and astral steel collided across time.

cs_ch1_1.speaker: Rift Gatekeeper Lyra
cs_ch1_1.text: Abyssal Imps and Puglin Marauders are breaching the northern gate! Clear the Outskirts Raiders, and rally your party!

cs_ch2_0.speaker: Gronk, Puglin Warlord
cs_ch2_0.text: Fresh steel wanders into my crypts! Come, heroes... feed your chrono-shards to the Bestiary!

cs_ch2_1.speaker: Blacksmith Kaelen
cs_ch2_1.text: Strike down Gronk and his pack. Their cores will temper your relics for the Astral Breach ahead!

cs_ch3_0.speaker: Xeno-Harbinger
cs_ch3_0.text: Timeline convergence detected. Astral Cyclops Juggernaut... purge all organic anomalies.

cs_ch3_1.speaker: Rift Gatekeeper Lyra
cs_ch3_1.text: Press Space to vault over the shockwaves, and focus fire on the Juggernaut!

cs_ch4_0.speaker: Archon Malakor
cs_ch4_0.text: I am the nexus of every broken age! Kneel before the Chrono-Fused Throne, mortals!

cs_ch4_1.speaker: High Cleric Seraphina
cs_ch4_1.text: Charge your Co-Op Synergy, and unleash Astral Convergence together. Now!

cs_ch5_0.speaker: Lorekeeper Aldous
cs_ch5_0.text: Malakor falls, and golden light breaks across Ashenvale. Yet deeper echoes stir, beyond the Endless Rift...

cs_ch5_1.speaker: Rift Gatekeeper Lyra
cs_ch5_1.text: Victory belongs to your party! Prepare yourselves. The Endless Rift escalates to the next tier!

kaelen_greet.speaker: Blacksmith Kaelen
kaelen_greet.text: Hail, hero! The Chrono-Rifts warped steel and starlight alike. Bring me your blades, and I'll temper them hot enough to cleave an Archon.

kaelen_temper.speaker: Blacksmith Kaelen
kaelen_temper.text: Hah! Feel that edge? That'll bite.

kaelen_forge.speaker: Blacksmith Kaelen
kaelen_forge.text: A fine relic. Wield it with pride.

kaelen_broke.speaker: Blacksmith Kaelen
kaelen_broke.text: Come back when your purse is heavier, friend.

seraphina_greet.speaker: High Cleric Seraphina
seraphina_greet.text: May the Twin Moons shield your spirit. Rest at the Sanctuary Shrine, and let Solaris mend your party's wounds.

seraphina_heal.speaker: High Cleric Seraphina
seraphina_heal.text: Be whole again, all of you.

seraphina_elixirs.speaker: High Cleric Seraphina
seraphina_elixirs.text: Three elixirs, freshly blessed. Use them well.

seraphina_blessing.speaker: High Cleric Seraphina
seraphina_blessing.text: Solaris burns within you. Strike true!

seraphina_sanctuary.speaker: High Cleric Seraphina
seraphina_sanctuary.text: The Sanctuary's blessing restores your party. Fight on.

lyra_greet.speaker: Rift Gatekeeper Lyra
lyra_greet.text: The Astral Gate hums with power. Step through when your squad is ready, or shift timelines at once.

lyra_wave.speaker: Rift Gatekeeper Lyra
lyra_wave.text: A new Rift Wave has awakened. Steel yourselves!

aldous_lore_0.speaker: Lorekeeper Aldous
aldous_lore_0.text: Before the Chrono-Rifts tore open the northern sky, Ashenvale Bastion stood as the serene frontier of Sunsteel knights and woodland trackers. Now, medieval stone and alien monoliths share one horizon.

aldous_lore_1.speaker: Lorekeeper Aldous
aldous_lore_1.text: Beneath the western crypts, Puglin Warlords and Abyssal Imps guard ancient chests, forged in flame and frost. Hunters who clear the catacombs harvest rare relics for Blacksmith Kaelen.

aldous_lore_2.speaker: Lorekeeper Aldous
aldous_lore_2.text: In the far northern Citadel hovers Malakor, the Chrono-Fused Archon. Armed with a void scythe and a golden broadsword, only coordinated Convergence can shatter his temporal shield.

aldous_tome.speaker: Lorekeeper Aldous
aldous_tome.text: The Chrono-Rifts tore open above Ashenvale Bastion, fusing medieval stone with future citadels. Forge mythic weapons, and strike down Archon Malakor!

malakor_engage.speaker: Archon Malakor
malakor_engage.text: So, the insects crawl to my throne. Your timelines end here!

malakor_half.speaker: Archon Malakor
malakor_half.text: You wound me? I have died a thousand times, in a thousand ages!

malakor_quarter.speaker: Archon Malakor
malakor_quarter.text: Enough! Let every age collapse upon you!

malakor_death.speaker: Archon Malakor
malakor_death.text: Impossible... The Rift... will consume... all timelines!

gronk_engage.speaker: Gronk, Puglin Warlord
gronk_engage.text: Smash the shiny ones! Gronk wants their shards!

hero_vanguard_revived.speaker: Vanguard Knight
hero_vanguard_revived.text: Back on my feet. For Ashenvale!

hero_arcanist_ult.speaker: Reaper Arcanist
hero_arcanist_ult.text: Time itself bends to us. Converge!

hero_berserker_spawn.speaker: Berserker Warlord
hero_berserker_spawn.text: The Warlord has arrived. Who's first?
